title: memory-refs: regular-file index targets, unbounded task reads, per-id stale status
body: Outcome: scripts/claude/memory-refs.ts (1) reports MISSING-INDEX when the link target is not a regular file (a directory foo.md hides a missing note); (2) reads tasks/<id>.json without the 256 KiB memory bound; (3) STALE-TASK binds status words to the nearest id so a line mixing open and closed ids keeps its status words. Evidence: #211 attempt-3 prepass findings (review-series 39f29216…/records/3.json) accepted by override; prune log .krn/runs/lead/memory-refs/prune-log.md.
